name: avatar
description: A person's picture in a circle. Shows a fallback, like initials or an icon, until the picture loads or when it fails.

props.size: small, medium, or large. Adds avatar--small, avatar--medium, or avatar--large. Large is the default.
props.as: React: the element to render, span by default. Use a or button for an avatar people can click. Plain HTML: put the avatar class on an <a> or <button>.

props.src: The picture. With no src, or when it fails to load, the fallback stays.
props.alt: Describes the picture. Use the person's name.

props.children: Initials or an icon. Shown until the image loads, and when it fails.

modifiers.avatar--small: A smaller avatar with smaller fallback text
modifiers.avatar--disabled: Lowers opacity and turns off pointer events

customPropertiesNote: Border, ring, and shadow values are box shadows. Use var(--op-border-none) to draw nothing. The border and ring draw on top of the image. Hover and focus apply only when the avatar is an <a> or <button>.

avatar.--op-avatar-border-color-hover: Color of the outer line when hovered
avatar.--op-avatar-ring-color-hover: Color of the inner ring when hovered
avatar.--op-avatar-ring: The inner ring, between the outer line and the picture

avatar__image.--op-avatar-image-fit: How the picture fills the circle

avatar__fallback.--op-avatar-fallback-background: Background behind the initials or icon
avatar__fallback.--op-avatar-fallback-color: Color of the initials or icon
